verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents an in-product Insights Agent that delivers proactive recommendations and conversational insights from a customer's own incident, service and team analytics. It also documents AI Orchestrations that analyze historical events and incidents to recommend rules, and PagerDuty Advance generative AI that summarizes incidents. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, deeper documentation of the Insights Agent's scope and limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: delivers proactive recommendations and on-demand conversational insights based on your Incidents, Services, and Teams analytics
automatically analyze historical events and incidents and surface recommended rules that reduce noise, improve MTTR, and accelerate automation setup
generative AI for summarizing key information about an incident
